learning_outcomes.text: Model simple and complex pattern recognition problems.
Display knowledge and understanding of the mathematical theory underlying the main classes of constrained (mainly) optimisation problems and the practical contexts in which such problems may arise.
Develop methods and techniques for pattern recognition in the laboratory using (mainly) the Python and Matlab programming environment.

Design and understand basic and advanced methods for data processing and analysis such as: Statistical analysis of data, Clustering (discovering and constructing groups of data), Classification (building statistical decision support systems), Using Neural Networks, Support Vector Machines, and advanced deep learning methods, Regression (constructing function approximation approaches), Dimension reduction (transformation methods for data and selecting most important features).

Discover the possibilities of all these methods as tools for data handling and knowledge extraction. For this purpose students either develop their own routines, or apply ready routines from Python and Matlab.
Recognize pattern recognition problems and select algorithms and methodologies to solve them.
Learn some of the traditional as well as the more recent tools for classification.
Construct a learning system to solve a given simple pattern recognition problem, using appropriate tools.
Read and comprehend recent articles in computer science and engineering-oriented fields.
Get hands-on experience in using some of these techniques, through homework.

syllabus_topics: Classifiers: linear functions and decision surfaces
Regression: linear regression and kernel-based regression models
Probability density estimation: (non-parametric) Parzen-windows and k-nearest neighbors
Application on the general multivariate case
Clustering techniques - Unsupervised learning: clustering and applications
teaching_methods: Course website maintenance (announcements, assignments, posting teaching material)
Use of email for information exchange and improved communication with students

assessment_methods.method: Take-home assignments (programming assignments on studying pattern recognition methods in real-life applications and applications related to scientific data analysis)

assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a final examination (70%) and take-home assignments (30%). Assignments are marked based on their correctness and completeness. The evaluation procedure is accessible to students via the course website.
